title: Technical Blog Template Extra Config Schema
description: Schema for extra_config fields used by technical-blog.jinja2 template

default_theme.description: Default color theme for syntax highlighting and UI

aliases.description: List of aliases for the article

themes.description: List of available themes for the theme selector (requires 2+ themes to show selector)

light_theme.description: Light theme of the default build's light/dark pair (applied via prefers-color-scheme, overridable per article)

dark_theme.description: Dark theme of the default build's light/dark pair (applied via prefers-color-scheme, overridable per article)

articles_per_page.description: Number of articles per feed page (feed template only)

preview_blocks.description: Number of leading block elements embedded per article in feed pages

hide_from_feed.description: Exclude this page from HTML feed listings (feed template only)

hide_meta.description: Hide the article byline (dates, version links) and the end-of-page version list (for static pages like about)

feed_depth.description: How many subdirectory levels below a feed page are included (also readable top-level)

source_path.description: Repo-root-relative path of this page's source file, for deep source links (e.g. site/range_constrained_types_in_c++.md)
